name: collector.shop
description: Marketplace d'objets de collection entre particuliers

scripts.dev-dockerise-migration: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml --env-file .env.local exec backend npm run migrate && docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml --env-file .env.local exec backend npm run seed
scripts.dev: npm run dev:services && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w frontend && npm run test:coverage -w backend
